title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Desk Guidance: Calibration Orders Held by One Customer
content:
A customer may hold any number of ADAS Sensor Calibrations orders across vehicles and sources; there is no customer-level cap on calibration orders.

The limit that does exist is set per source, not per customer: per source, the limit on open calibration orders for one glass job, insurance claim repair, customer-pay repair or warranty rework applies.

## The rule in table form

| Counted across | Limit |
|---|---|
| All of one customer's calibration orders, on all vehicles and all sources | none: no customer-level cap |
| The calibration orders of one source | the per-source limit on open calibration orders |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A customer with three vehicles, each with a calibration order opened after a different repair, holds three orders. The number of orders the customer holds is not limited.
- A fleet account with calibration orders open on many vehicles is in the same position: the number of calibration orders the customer holds is not capped.
